cli.usage:
puuush: give a file
example: puuush --cli ~/Desktop/screen.png
cli.broken: puuush --cli: the settings were not read, the upload is blocked. Fix settings.json and try again.
cli.headless:
puuush --cli: no display. Run it like this:
  xvfb-run -a puuush --cli file.png
or with DISPLAY, if there is a graphical session.

ui.description: Settings. A screenshot of a region, the upload, the link in the clipboard.
ui.brokenTitle: The settings file was not read.
ui.brokenBody: The values you see are the defaults. If you had chosen “own server only”, the next screenshot may go to a public host. The settings save themselves: fix the fields you need, and it all takes effect.
ui.field.writeKeyPlaceholder: the key the server gave you
ui.check.openInBrowser: Open the link in the browser
ui.check.keepLocalCopy: Keep local copies of screenshots and recordings
ui.hint.keepLocalCopy: Turn this off to delete screenshots and uploaded recordings after sending. Recording modes that save to disk or clipboard still keep the file.
ui.hint.hotkey: Press the field, then the combination. It needs at least one modifier: Command, Ctrl or Alt. Shift alone does not count, and a bare key is not accepted: it would take that key away from every application. The change saves itself. Esc, Tab and Backspace leave the field without erasing anything.
ui.hint.key: The key travels in the {method} header, and it is in neither the link nor the server log. If the server is down, the upload goes to a public host.
ui.hint.keyOwn: The key travels in the {method} header, and it is in neither the link nor the server log. If the server is down, the upload fails: in this mode nothing is sent to a public host.
ui.hint.behaviour: “Open in the browser” switches focus to the browser after each upload, so it is harder to paste the link straight into a chat.
ui.hint.launchAtLogin: The hotkey works only while the app is running, so it can start with the system.
ui.next.ownReady: The next screenshot will go to your own server. If it is down, the upload will not happen.
ui.next.ownMissing: The own server is not set up: fill in the address and the key, or the screenshot will not upload.
ui.next.autoReady: The next screenshot will go to your own server, and if it is down — to a public host.
ui.next.autoMissing: The own server is not set up, the next screenshot will go to a public host.
ui.next.public: The next screenshot will go to {host}, which is a public host.
ui.server.ok: the server answers, the key fits.
ui.server.okFiles: the server answers, the key fits. It holds {count} {word}, {size}.
ui.server.bad: the server is not set up or does not answer: {detail}
ui.server.saveFailed: the settings were not saved, the check is cancelled
ui.upload.label: Drop a file here
ui.upload.chooseLabel: or choose one — it will be uploaded and the link copied
ui.history.emptyDescription: The links will appear here after the first upload.

ui.gallery.noMatchesDescription: Choose another filter to see files.
ui.gallery.fileMissing: No local copy is available. Turn on “Keep local copies” in Settings to preview screenshots and open files here.
ui.gallery.copyFileHint: If the system cannot copy files to the clipboard, the file path is copied instead.
ui.gallery.moveTitle: Choose a folder for this file
ui.gallery.sameFolder: The file is already in this folder
ui.gallery.sourceRemains: The file was copied, but the original could not be removed
ui.gallery.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
ui.gallery.unavailable: The file is no longer available
ui.rendererNotBuilt: The app windows are not built. Run npm run build:renderer and restart puuush.

ui.status.noPath: could not work out the path of the file

overlay.hint.after: Release the mouse — the shot is ready. {cancel} to cancel, {space} for the whole screen

note.shotStillPicking: the previous screenshot is still being picked, Esc cancels it

ui.hostOwnOnly: own server only — nothing leaves this machine
ui.hint.language: The language of the whole application: the tray, the notifications and this window.
ui.readFailed: the settings could not be read
ui.hostsFailed: the list of hosts did not load: {error}

ui.history.confirmClear: Clear the file and link history? Files on disk will stay.
ui.history.clearFailed: the history could not be cleared
ui.hint.recordSystemAudio: The system sound can only be recorded on Windows: there the app can take the sound from the output device. On other systems only the microphone is left.
ui.hint.recordScreen: Choose a specific monitor, the screen under the pointer, or all screens side by side in one frame.
ui.displaysFailed: The list of screens did not load: {error}
ui.hint.recording: The same hotkey starts the recording and stops it. While it runs, a frame is on the screen and a panel with the timer, pause and stop sits at the bottom.
local.failed: the local share did not start: {error}
ui.local.label: Local link (works while the app is open)
capture.pickHandlerFailed: the picker answered after it was closed:
ui.hint.recordAllScreens: Off: the screen with the pointer is recorded. On: every monitor in one frame, side by side.
upload.redirectStream: the server answered with a redirect to another upload, the file would be sent twice, so the upload stopped
rec.windowGone: the recording window closed, the recording was interrupted
ui.speed.hint: Measures the upload from this computer: different regions get different fastest hosts.
ui.speed.done: measured, working hosts: {count}. The fast ones are tried first now.
ui.speed.none: no cloud host answered; the own server is all that is left
upload.hostTooSmall: {host}: the file {size} is over the {max} limit, skipping
upload.tooBigForHost: the file {size} does not fit into {host}. {reasons} Pick another host or your own server.
upload.hostRecentlyFailed: {host} did not answer recently, skipping it for five more minutes
rec.startTimeout: the recording did not start within 20 seconds: the browser did not give the screen or the microphone
ui.option.recordTarget.cloud: To the cloud, link in the clipboard
ui.option.recordTarget.both: Both the cloud and the disk
ui.hint.recordTarget: With the disk, the file stays in the screenshots folder and no link is made.
ui.hint.recordMicGain: If the voice is quiet on the recording, raise it to 150% or 200%. Audio processing is off, so the volume is not cut.
ui.status.recordOnDisk: The recording is saved to the disk
ui.field.photoMode: What to do with a screenshot
ui.option.video.clipboard: Save the file and copy it
ui.hint.videoMode.link: When you stop, the recording uploads to the selected host and its link is copied to the clipboard.
ui.hint.videoMode.clipboard: The file stays on disk. Windows copies it to the clipboard as a file for pasting into a chat or Explorer; other systems copy its path. Nothing is uploaded and no link is made.
ui.hint.videoMode.disk: The file stays in the screenshots and recordings folder. No link is made; the file path is copied to the clipboard.
ui.hint.recordArea: A region is asked for with the same frame as a screenshot, before the recording starts.
ui.hint.format.video: WebM can include sound. Turn the microphone and system audio on below, or clear both boxes to record silently.
ui.hint.format.gif: GIF is always silent. Choose WebM video to record sound.
ui.hint.recordFps: GIF width is capped: up to 1600 pixels at 30 fps and 960 at 60. If the encoder falls behind, frames are skipped instead of stretching the recording.
